mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the GDP growth rate over the past 4 quarters, as measured by GDPC1, signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically has led to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 shows a decline but S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over the past 3 months signals a tightening monetary cycle, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% but S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5% over the past 6 months signals labor market weakness, which historically has led to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE exceeds 5% but S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is rejected.
